cover.headline: This week's *biggest* AI moves
teasers: Anthropic takes its IPO plans on the road
NVIDIA's GR00T 2 teaches robots from video
ChatGPT Images 2.6 now makes animated GIFs
AI data centres push US power to records

stories.headline: Anthropic takes its *IPO* plans on the road
stories.body: The Claude maker has started its IPO roadshow, a big step towards listing on the stock market.

stories.headline: NVIDIA's *GR00T 2* learns from human video
stories.body: The robot model tests whether watching people do tasks helps robots pick up new skills faster.

stories.headline: ChatGPT Images 2.6 makes *animated GIFs*
stories.body: The update adds native GIF generation and reference images that persist, plus two new API models.

stories.headline: AI data centres push US power use to *records*
stories.body: The US energy agency expects electricity use to hit new highs in 2026 and 2027, partly due to AI.

stories.headline: Meta pauses its *website-scraping* terms
stories.body: After rulings in Norway and Brazil, Meta indefinitely paused terms that would let it scrape business users' sites.
